args.description: Analyze this PostgreSQL database for the biggest tables. Use the inventory-analyst approach. Return a ranked list of the top tables by total size, and include for each table: schema.table name, total size, table size, index size, TOAST size if available, and row count if you can provide an estimate or exact count from your analysis. Keep it concise and numeric only; do not speculate. If exact row counts are not easily available, omit them rather than estimating. Mention if the database is a primary/replica if relevant. Focus on the largest tables overall.
